text:
Location: Ton Son Nhut
At the flight line probably 3 blocks away. There was a Beaver airplane made by Canadian company Dehavolond. The plane I flew to Hong Kong in was made by DeHavoland. I can't think of the name of the plane. It had a quick hightail, really short, two engines on the wings and it was short take off and landing. There were really popular because of the short landing strip and I think they held 18 guys
researchNotes: Two things at one photograph: the flight line 'probably 3 blocks away' with a Beaver on it (the Beaver is drawn on VD-0004), and a separate story, the flight to Hong Kong in a de Havilland he names in the next comment. The trip to Hong Kong is new to the archive.
